name: minecraft-redstone
description: Connect Codex to a local Minecraft Java world for building, inspecting and testing vanilla redstone.

interface.shortDescription: Build and inspect Minecraft with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Local Minecraft world/player/inventory access plus optional compact telemetry: cache snapshots, send only changed fields, and request reduced screenshots explicitly. Requires a compatible game-side Fabric bridge. Independent observer still needs implementation. The personal telemetry runner requires local Node.js.
defaultPrompt: Check the Minecraft connection and inspect my redstone test area.
Help me build and understand my next redstone circuit.
